title: SNAP Quality Control (QC) public-use microdata: characteristics of SNAP households (snapqcdata.net)
agency: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Food and Nutrition Administration (formerly Food and Nutrition Service); files prepared by Mathematica under contract
questions: how many SNAP households have earnings, children, elderly or disabled members (national or by state)
the distribution of SNAP households by gross income as a share of poverty
average SNAP benefit, gross and net income and deductions of SNAP households
characteristics of SNAP participants by age, citizenship or work status
simulating a change to SNAP benefit or deduction rules on the current caseload

manual.how: Open each link in manual_download/INSTRUCTIONS.md in a browser (no account or form), save the CSV zip under the name shown and upload it. Without the links: open https://snapqcdata.net/datafiles, find the fiscal year's heading and download the row 'QC Data | CSV' (qcfyYYYY_csv.zip); the technical documentation PDF is in the same group.

cache.why: One CSV zip a fiscal year (1-6 MB); data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: Public-use file released by USDA FNA (personal identifiers and sub-state geography removed); USDA's Ag Data Commons copy of the FY 2022 database carries the U.S. Public Domain label (checked 2026-10-31); snapqcdata.net states no terms.

citation: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Food and Nutrition Administration, SNAP Quality Control Database, public-use file (prepared by Mathematica), {dataset}, snapqcdata.net, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Average month of the fiscal year or one month? Default: the fiscal-year average (FYWGT), as FNA's Characteristics of SNAP Households report does.
SNAP units (households as certified) or persons? Default: say which; persons are FSUSIZE-weighted units or FSAFIL = 1 person rows.
Standard errors needed? The replicate weights are SAS datasets this pack does not read. Default: report weighted estimates without standard errors, said so, and suppress cells with few sample units.
